reviews.text: This overnight mask can be applied after the Toner and Serum. Leave for 15 mins to dry before going to bed. Remove the mask by peeling and/or rinsing with lukewarm water. The formula contains Niacinamide to improve skin tone and texture, Ceramide to protect the skin barrier and Hyaluronic acid for deep hydration. The bubblegum pink colour makes this mask so much fun to use and peeling off the mask is so satisfying. Perfect for pamper nights and girly get-togethers!
reviews.zh: 呢款隔夜面膜可以喺化妝水同精華之後使用。睡覺前等佢乾 15 分鐘。用撕走嘅方式或者用溫水沖洗去除面膜。配方含有煙酰胺，改善膚色同質地，神經醯胺保護皮膚屏障，透明質酸深層補水。泡泡糖粉紅色令用面膜都好有趣，撕走面膜嗰種感覺好有滿足感。啱晒用嚟做護膚之夜同女仔聚會！

reviews.text:
Skin: combo, dull in winter.
This is a pink gel wrapping mask, you apply a medium layer as last step at night, it forms a film and locks everything in for 8 hours. In the morning it peels off like a second skin.
Texture: bouncy gel, no strong scent, not heavy. Doesn't stain pillow if you let it dry 15 min.
How I use: After serum and moisturizer, 2-3 times a week. I sleep with it and peel off in the morning, then rinse.
Result: When I wake up skin is super hydrated, plump, less dull, pores look smoother and makeup sits better. Not irritating for me.
Tip: Apply evenly, not too thin or it won't peel. Perfect for night before event.
reviews.zh:
膚質：混合性，冬天會暗啞。
呢款係粉紅色嘅凝膠包覆面膜，晚上最後一步塗一層適中嘅份量，佢會形成一層薄膜，鎖住所有嘢八個鐘。朝早佢會好似第二層皮膚咁撕走。
質地：有彈性嘅凝膠，冇咩濃烈香味，唔會覺得厚重。如果等佢乾十五分鐘，就唔會染污枕頭。
我點樣用：喺精華同保濕霜之後，每星期用兩至三次。我戴住佢瞓覺，朝早撕走，然後沖洗。
效果：我醒嚟嗰時皮膚好水潤、飽滿、冇咁暗啞，毛孔睇落更加平滑，化妝亦貼得更好。對我嚟講唔會刺激。
小貼士：塗得平均啲，唔好太薄，否則撕唔到。啱晒活動前一晚用。

reviews.text:
This mask is perfect for those nights when my skin needs some extra care. I apply it before going to bed and love how comfortable it feels while I sleep.

In the morning, my skin looks fresh and feels noticeably softer and smoother. It’s also a great way to give my skincare routine a little extra boost without adding a complicated step.

I really like the idea of a sleeping mask that works while I rest. Definitely one I’ll keep using!
reviews.zh:
呢款面膜啱晒皮膚需要額外護理嘅晚上。我瞓覺前敷，好鍾意佢瞓落去嗰陣嘅舒適感。

朝早起身，我嘅皮膚睇落好靚，感覺明顯更柔軟、更順滑。亦都係一個好好嘅方法，可以為我嘅護膚程序加多啲效果，而且唔需要多加一個複雜步驟。

我好鍾意「可以喺我休息嗰時繼續發揮功效嘅睡眠面膜」呢個概念。一定會繼續用落去！

reviews.text:
I’ve been loving this overnight mask! The texture feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin, and I really like that it forms a thin wrapping layer that you can simply rinse off in the morning. My skin feels noticeably softer, smoother and more hydrated after using it.

The combination of niacinamide, tranexamic acid, ceramide and hyaluronic acid makes it a great addition to my evening routine, especially when my skin looks dull or uneven. I also love waking up with that fresh, healthy-looking glow.

Definitely one of those products that makes my nighttime skincare routine feel a little more luxurious. ✨
reviews.zh:
我一直好鍾意呢款隔夜面膜！質地輕盈、貼住皮膚都舒服，我好鍾意佢會形成一層薄薄嘅包覆膜，朝早用清水沖走就得。用完之後，我嘅皮膚明顯更加柔軟、順滑、水潤。

煙酰胺、傳明酸、神經醯胺同透明質酸嘅組合，令佢成為我晚上護膚程序嘅好選擇，尤其係皮膚睇落暗啞或者膚色唔均勻嗰時。我亦好鍾意朝早醒嚟嗰種清新、健康嘅光澤感。

呢款係令我晚上護膚程序感覺更加奢華嘅產品之一。✨

reviews.text: I really enjoyed using the APRILSKIN TXA Niacinamide 99 Night Wrapping Mask! The texture feels smooth and comfortable on the skin, and it creates a light protective layer overnight without feeling too heavy. In the morning, my skin feels soft, hydrated, and refreshed. I also love that it gives my skin a more bright and even-looking appearance with consistent use. Such a nice addition to my nighttime routine!
reviews.zh: 我真係好享受用 APRILSKIN TXA Niacinamide 99 Night Wrapping Mask！質地幼滑、貼住皮膚都舒服，隔夜會形成一層輕薄嘅保護層，但唔會覺得太厚重。朝早起身，我嘅皮膚感覺柔軟、水潤、清爽。持續使用之後，我亦鍾意佢令皮膚睇落更加亮白、膚色更加均勻。係我晚上護膚程序嘅一個好好嘅新增產品！

reviews.text: I've been using this mask a few times a week and really like how my skin feels in the morning. It leaves my skin soft, hydrated and looking more refreshed. The texture is comfortable and doesn't feel sticky when you sleep. I also really enjoy peeling it off in the morning. It's easy to remove and oddly satisfying. A great option if you're looking for an easy overnight mask with brightening and glow benefits.
reviews.zh: 我每星期用呢款隔夜面膜幾次，好鍾意朝早起身後皮膚嘅感覺。佢令皮膚柔軟、水潤，睇落更加有精神。質地好舒服，瞓覺時唔會覺得黏。我亦好享受朝早撕走佢嘅過程，容易撕，而且好奇怪地令人滿足。如果你想搵一款容易使用嘅隔夜面膜，同時有提亮同光澤嘅功效，呢款係好嘅選擇。

reviews.text:
I’ve used this mask a few nights and I can already see results. The texture is lightweight, non-sticky, and absorbs well into the skin. In the morning my face looks more even-toned, brighter, and deeply hydrated. I love the ingredients – niacinamide, tranexamic acid, ceramides – they really help with post-acne marks and strengthening the skin barrier.

It doesn’t cause irritation and works well even on combination and sensitive skin. I definitely recommend it if you’re looking for hydration and a more radiant complexion.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommend!
reviews.zh:
我用咗呢款面膜幾個晚上，已經見到效果。質地輕盈、唔黏，吸收得好。朝早起身，我嘅面睇落更加均勻、更亮白，水分充足。我好鍾意佢嘅成分——煙酰胺、傳明酸、神經醯胺——佢哋真係幫助改善暗瘡印，同加強皮膚屏障。

佢唔會刺激，即使係混合性同敏感皮膚都用得好。如果你想搵一款水潤同更有光澤嘅面膜，我一定推薦。

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 強力推薦！
